themes.name: Memory cycle
themes.summary: HBM, commodity DRAM and NAND must be evaluated separately; one blended memory label hides materially different supply-demand and late-cycle risks.

subthemes.name: HBM
subthemes.monitor: AI accelerator demand, capacity qualification, packaging constraints, content per system and customer attempts to reduce memory content.

subthemes.name: Commodity DRAM
subthemes.monitor: Pricing, supply discipline, node transitions, inventory and whether capacity additions arrive faster than demand.

subthemes.name: NAND
subthemes.monitor: Consumer demand, capacity returns, pricing discipline and whether NAND supply loosens earlier than HBM or DRAM.

invalidation: HBM qualification or packaging constraints ease materially faster than demand grows.
Commodity DRAM pricing and inventory reverse while suppliers accelerate capacity.
AI infrastructure demand weakens enough to reduce memory content growth.

themes.name: AI capex and infrastructure
themes.summary: NVDA, MU, AVGO, MRVL and LITE can move together when the market reprices AI infrastructure spending; symbol-level signals must include shared capex-sentiment risk.

subthemes.name: Optical interconnect
subthemes.monitor: AI datacenter optical demand, transceiver pricing and share, customer concentration and capacity execution.

invalidation: Hyperscaler capex guidance weakens broadly rather than shifting between vendors.
Options-market fear and credit stress confirm that a price decline is structural rather than positioning noise.

themes.name: Portfolio hedge
themes.summary: A hedge is held to reduce an identified unwanted factor or tail risk while preserving intended alpha. Recognition as a put or ETF hedge does not prove economic effectiveness.

subthemes.name: Broad-market and semiconductor hedge instruments
subthemes.monitor: Delta offset, basis risk versus the actual portfolio, expiry mismatch, convexity, liquidity, carry and whether the hedge still targets the intended risk.

invalidation: The hedge no longer offsets the intended risk factor or creates larger unintended exposure.
Expiry, liquidity, carry or basis risk makes the protection economically ineffective.
The underlying portfolio thesis or risk budget changes enough that the original hedge objective is obsolete.

theses.summary: Mixed HBM, DRAM and NAND exposure; monitor each component separately instead of extrapolating one memory datapoint to the whole company.
catalysts: HBM qualification, capacity and content growth
AI server demand and customer memory configurations
invalidation: HBM or DRAM supply-demand turns decisively before earnings expectations adjust.
AI capex weakness becomes broad and persistent.
Management guidance or margins deteriorate beyond a normal memory-cycle fluctuation.

theses.summary: Core AI-capex barometer; evaluate price weakness together with put skew, volatility demand, support and shared infrastructure sentiment.
catalysts: Platform shipment and customer capex updates
Next-generation system configuration and memory content
invalidation: Put skew and volatility rise with a confirmed break of support and earnings expectations.

theses.summary: More direct NAND-cycle exposure than MU; upside and late-cycle oversupply risk should not be inferred from HBM or DRAM data.
invalidation: NAND supply returns faster than end demand.
